page_title: CRY 0-2 FUL | Crystal Palace v Fulham 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Dean Henderson displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Adama Traore (Fulham) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
90+5' The goal by Fulham is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
90+4' Wait! Referee Michael Salisbury has indicated he is going to review the Fulham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
90+3' Harry Wilson (Fulham) gets on the end of a long pass that is slotted through the defence and easily sends the ball into the bottom left corner!
90+1' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
89' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Alex Iwobi is replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).
89' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Daniel Munoz and he is replaced by Caleb Kporha (Crystal Palace).
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harrison Reed (Fulham) comes onto the pitch for Emile Smith Rowe.
88' Substitution. Asher Agbinone (Crystal Palace) has come on for Ismaila Sarr.
86' Fulham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
85' Caution goes to Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace).
83' Today's match ends for Andreas Pereira who will be replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).

83' 0 - 2 Alex Iwobi produces a sweet pass and picks out Harry Wilson (Fulham) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:2!
82' Here is a change. Reiss Nelson is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Harry Wilson (Fulham).
80' A pass from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is intercepted by Dean Henderson and the move breaks down.
78' The ratio of the ball possession is 38:62.

76' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) must think that he is playing a different sport because his behaviour has nothing to do with football and the referee has no choice but to show him a straight red card!
75' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Raul Jimenez will be replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
74' Justin Devenny comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace).
71' Fulham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
70' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Alex Iwobi (Fulham), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Fulham win a corner.

69' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
68' Crystal Palace are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
67' An attempted cross from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is cleared. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

65' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Bernd Leno makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.
63' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) receives a yellow card for infringement.
62' The substitution is prepared. Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nathaniel Clyne.
62' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Michael Salisbury blows for a foul.

59' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
59' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Fulham.

58' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Dean Henderson, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Fulham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
57' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
57' The ball is cleared after Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Fulham.
55' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Fulham due to an offside in the build-up play.
53' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Fulham players aren’t happy.
52' It's 0:2! Alex Iwobi feeds Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.

49' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno pulls off a comfortable save.
46' Kenny Tete (Fulham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+2' 0 - 1 Goal! Raul Jimenez displays great vision and sends a pass to Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
45+2' Sander Berge (Fulham) is penalised for holding. Michael Salisbury signals a set piece.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
43' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
42' A dangerous looking corner kick from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is cleared to safety by the defence.

41' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes out for a corner. Fulham can continue in their attacking effort.
40' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
39' A pass by Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
38' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) whips in a cross from the corner, but Dean Henderson is well positioned and punches the ball away.
37' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is out of play and Fulham manage to earn a corner.
35' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It's a throw-in for Fulham.

33' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.

31' That's unlucky! Antonee Robinson (Fulham) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.

28' A dangerous towering header by Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
28' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Crystal Palace.

27' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
27' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) is able to continue to play.
26' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
22' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.

19' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Jean-Philippe Mateta, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
17' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
15' One of the players from Fulham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
14' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Dean Henderson is alert and denies him.

12' Fulham slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
10' Bernd Leno displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
8' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
6' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
4' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) attempts to release Daichi Kamada with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
3' Fulham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
2' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Fulham get a corner.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
Michael Salisbury got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
